title: Bump the runtime group with 2 updates
body:
Bumps the runtime group with 2 updates: [ms](https://github.com/vercel/ms) and @acme/telemetry. Updates `ms` from 2.1.2 to 2.1.3
Release notes

Sourced from ms's releases.

2.1.3

  • Rename zeit to vercel
Updates `@acme/telemetry` from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 --- Dependabot will resolve any conflicts with this PR as long as you don't alter it yourself.
